excerpt: Solving Seasonal Labour Shortages: Best Practices for Recruiting Agricultural Workers Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Equity and Diversity in Talent Acquisition go beyond simple representation. They are about creating opportunities, removing barriers, and ensuring that every candidate, regardless of background, has a fair chance to succeed. In a modern, competitive job market, equitable hiring is not only a moral obligation but a strategic driver of innovation, performance, and organizational growth. The Growing Importance of Equity in Today’s Workforce As the nature of work evolves, so do candidate expectations.
